# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We want participation in this project to be a harassment-free experience for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion,
or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- be direct, specific, and kind;
- criticise ideas and code, not people;
- assume good faith, ask before assuming intent;
- accept that a maintainer may close a contribution without a long debate.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- harassment, insults, or discriminatory comments;
- publishing private information without permission;
- sustained disruption of discussions or reviews;
- any conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope

This applies in issues, pull requests, discussions, and any space where someone
represents the project.

## Enforcement

Report concerns privately to the maintainer. Reports are reviewed promptly and
confidentially. Responses range from a warning to a permanent ban, depending on
severity and repetition. The maintainer is responsible for enforcement and will
avoid conflicts of interest.
